baseline.note: Three independent reviews of the exact public release. Each reviewer left unsupported criteria unknown and therefore provided no full 100-point score. Points are over assessed rubric weight, not a normalized score. Distinct major gates were reproduced across reviewers.

owner: Codex in James-approved Peninsula Insider task
finding: At 320/390/1440 the released Stay hub had 26 current listings, functional filters and no horizontal overflow, but Mornington Find stays returned 0 of 26. Linked stay detail pages falsely called fixed unrelated cards Nearby picks and More from the current town. The first guide card promised best places but began with category routes. FAQ schema and visible answers asserted a universal 60-minute Mornington trip and autumn midweek best value without a current source. A later local visual pass found an additional rights/visual leak: the sitewide browser image hydrator painted an uncredited CMS venue image onto a Stay card whose build had rejected that override, leaving an Add photo placeholder watermark over the photograph. Independent QA also found broken Visit Victoria Source links made from asset-reference text and a Polperro CMS-hosted photo without recorded reuse permission.
hypothesis: Inventory-aware base actions, place-and-zone ranked Stay comparisons with honest headings, and copy aligned to actual guide contents and verifiable rates will restore truthful decision paths without losing working filters or booking routes. Keeping Stay venue images tied to the vetted build and allowing explicitly rights-verified regional illustrations in comparison cards will remove the misleading, uncredited runtime image without sacrificing useful visual context.
boundedChange: Rank current non-spa Stay detail recommendations by same town, then same zone, then same type, with a generic comparison heading. Give Wine a generic heading because its shared template also selects across towns; retain Eat local wording. Make base-card Find stays conditional on current directory inventory, and direct the zero-stock Mornington card to its town page with a clear availability note. Retitle the category-first guide card. Remove unsupported fixed travel-time and seasonal-value claims from visible FAQ and matching JSON-LD. Skip public runtime venue-image hydration on /stay/ pages so the vetted build image and its disclosure stay together. In related Stay cards only, show content illustrations when provenance is verified, rights are recorded and source/licence/credit exist; label them explicitly as illustrative. All Stay detail and related-card heroes now ignore CMS overrides until upload rights evidence is supported. A scoped brand plate replaces visitor-facing Add photo chrome where no approved photo is shown. Only absolute HTTP(S) image source references render as links. Polperro uses an already licensed Peninsula vineyard illustration with explicit not-the-property disclosure.
metric: No base-card Find stays link may lead to zero active directory results; all 26 active Stay detail pages must omit false same-town/nearby claims and recommend only current listed stays. Stay hub and detail pages must build, render without overflow at 320/390/1440, and preserve filters, menu, consent, booking and keyboard operation. Independent QA must accept the bounded fixes; exact public release must match the merged SHA and show them. A real published CMS override that lacks rights metadata must not replace the built Stay image on reload. Vetted illustrative comparison photos must load with an explicit not-the-property disclosure and source/licence links; no visible Add photo watermark may sit over a painted photo. No Stay hero may render the old Polperro CMS photo or any uncredited CMS slot; no Visit Victoria asset-reference text may become a clickable Source link.
rollback: Revert this bounded Stay journey commit. No data migration or booking endpoint change.
